Toll Brothers


July 7, 2026


Hello, Bibi! We’re thrilled to hear you’re ready to begin your journey toward finding your forever home, and we truly appreciate you considering Toll Brothers.


Here are a few ways to get started:


**Explore our Connecticut communities and home designs** : Browse available options on[our website](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Connecticut) to see what best fits your lifestyle. Every community and home design page includes contact information for a local Online Sales Consultant who can answer your questions and guide you through the process.


**Submit a Sales Inquiry** : Complete our[Sales Inquiry form](https://www.tollbrothers.com/contact/sales-inquiries) , and a member of our team will reach out to help you get started.


**Comment your home design criteria** : Let us know what you’re looking for, and we’ll recommend communities and home designs that best match your preferences in these comments.


Please let us know if you have any questions along the way. We’re excited to help you find the perfect home and look forward to being part of your homebuying journey!
